description: Stage 0 frozen benchmark specifications for the AVID World-Model & Classical Baseline Evaluation Suite (5 benchmarks across 3 noise families).

A1_GATE_CROSSTALK.physical_reference: Ketterer and Wellens, Phys. Rev. Applied 20, 034065 (2023)
A1_GATE_CROSSTALK.physical_system: Three-transmon neighbourhood (Q1, Q2 target pair + Q3 spectator/concurrent neighbour)
A1_GATE_CROSSTALK.noise_mechanism: Schedule-conditioned simultaneous-gate crosstalk (residual ZZ + microwave drive crosstalk)
A1_GATE_CROSSTALK.evaluation_target: Schedule-conditioned local correlation forecast P(E_i, E_j | b_t, u_t)

isolated_zz_coupling_khz.source: Baseline idle/isolated residual coupling for transmon triplet test

concurrent_zz_coupling_khz.source: Active concurrent-schedule ZZ coupling for transmon triplet test

gate_duration_ns.source: Two-qubit/concurrent Clifford step duration in QuTiP reference

A2_CHIPWIDE_EVENTS.physical_system: 4-qubit spatially separated superconducting transmon array (0 to 1200 um spacing)
A2_CHIPWIDE_EVENTS.noise_mechanism: Phonon/quasiparticle-mediated transient correlated relaxation bursts from substrate radiation impacts
A2_CHIPWIDE_EVENTS.reference_simulator: QuTiP (time-dependent Lindblad amplitude damping mesolve across multi-qubit array)
A2_CHIPWIDE_EVENTS.scalable_qec_simulator: Stim + spatiotemporal event field g(r, t) injection layer
A2_CHIPWIDE_EVENTS.evaluation_target: Common-event detection, spatial footprint estimation, and transient relaxation decay forecast

spatial_correlation_length_um.source: Wilen et al. (2021) reported >600 um correlated charge/relaxation length scale

baseline_t1_us.source: Representative transmon baseline T1 before radiation burst

event_decay_rounds.source: Scaled QEC-round decay constant for tractable trajectory benchmarking

B1_TRANSMON_LEAKAGE.physical_reference: Varbanov et al., npj Quantum Information 6, 102 (2020)
B1_TRANSMON_LEAKAGE.physical_system: Distance-3 Surface-17 transmon unit cell (qutrit {|0>, |1>, |2>} data + ancilla stabilizer check)
B1_TRANSMON_LEAKAGE.noise_mechanism: Net-Zero CZ gate leakage into |2>, seepage to computational subspace, and conditional phase scrambling
B1_TRANSMON_LEAKAGE.reference_simulator: QuTiP (qutrit-qubit density-matrix stabilizer cycle + Markovian {C, L} transition dynamics)
B1_TRANSMON_LEAKAGE.evaluation_target: Per-transmon leakage posterior P(L_i(t)=1 | o_1:t), detection delay, and persistence forecast

cz_leakage_L1_baseline.source: Varbanov et al. (2020), baseline L1 = 0.125% per CZ

cz_leakage_L1_sensitivity.source: Varbanov et al. (2020), higher sensitivity L1 = 0.5% per CZ

expected_data_leakage_persistence_cycles.source: Varbanov et al. (2020), average data-qubit leakage persistence ~16 cycles

expected_ancilla_leakage_persistence_cyc.source: Varbanov et al. (2020), average ancilla leakage persistence ~17 cycles

flux_dance_cz_per_round.source: Surface-17 interior data qubit interacts with 4 CZ gates per QEC cycle

cz_flux_pulse_ns.source: Varbanov et al. (2020), 30 ns bipolar flux pulse + two 10 ns phase-correction pulses

C1_DRIVEN_TLS.physical_system: Driven superconducting transmon coherently coupled to a microscopic Two-Level System (TLS) defect
C1_DRIVEN_TLS.noise_mechanism: Drive-conditioned non-Markovian qubit-TLS exchange and slow TLS coupling drift under mirrored pseudoidentity U(theta)=X_{-theta}X_{+theta}
C1_DRIVEN_TLS.reference_simulator: QuTiP (composite Transmon x TLS Hamiltonian mesolve without inter-round environment reset)
C1_DRIVEN_TLS.scalable_qec_simulator: Stim + drive-conditioned latent TLS memory process
C1_DRIVEN_TLS.evaluation_target: Temporal and drive-amplitude-conditioned error prediction across horizons H in {1,2,4,8}

gate_sequence.source: Agarwal et al. (2023), mirrored pseudoidentity sequence

tls_coupling_range_mhz.source: Slowly varying transmon-TLS dipole coupling strength in QuTiP composite reference

drive_amplitudes_mhz.source: Drive amplitude sweep testing quadratic phase-error scaling and TLS back-action

C2_IDLE_MEMORY.physical_reference: Gulacsi and Burkard, Phys. Rev. B 107, 174511 (2023)
C2_IDLE_MEMORY.physical_system: Idle superconducting transmon coupled to a structured non-Markovian memory bath
C2_IDLE_MEMORY.noise_mechanism: Environmental memory during idle/measurement windows causing periodic coherence revivals, sideband precession frequencies, and negative canonical TCL decay rates
C2_IDLE_MEMORY.reference_simulator: QuTiP (composite qubit-memory Hamiltonian & Time-Convolutionless canonical rate extraction)
C2_IDLE_MEMORY.scalable_qec_simulator: Stim + history-kernel non-Markovian idle phase/relaxation channel
C2_IDLE_MEMORY.evaluation_target: Multi-horizon coherence revival and history-dependent idle fault prediction across H in {1,2,4,8}

memory_coupling_mhz.source: Composite bath coupling producing periodic coherence revivals and negative TCL rate

bath_detuning_mhz.source: Detuned memory mode generating secondary precession frequency peak

bath_damping_mhz.source: Finite bath correlation time tau_c > 1/g_mem (non-Markovian regime)
